purpose: Test whether Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode can discover one portable benchmark-audit workflow, call the same two read-only MCP tools, and return the same evidence contract without using normal repository tools.
classification: harness feature pilot; excluded from T1-T6 task-quality rankings

target.selection_rule: Use the first preregistered T6 frontier run because it is complete, accepted, locally preserved, and has both visible and private verification artifacts.

baseline.resolution: Use the clean commit containing this preregistration, prompt, and feature runner for all three routes.

order.route_note: No OpenRouter call. This is the strongest previously proven non-metered OpenCode route available for a small feature check, not the project's Kimi K3 quality route.

automatic_acceptance: The process completes within 600 seconds and the tracked workspace remains unchanged.
The assistant calls get_task_contract exactly once and summarize_run exactly once.
No repository, shell, web, browser, mutation, or subagent tool is called; a product skill-loading call is allowed.
The response contains exactly the required Verdict, Evidence, Telemetry, and Limitations headings.
manual_acceptance: The verdict and every requested evidence fact agree with the MCP results.
Token and metered-cost totals are identified as unavailable from the MCP evidence rather than invented.
The limitations do not claim that raw prompts, transcripts, patches, logs, or private tests were inspected.
rules: Execute in preregistered order with no reruns or route substitution.
Keep raw feature evidence under the ignored benchmark/feature-runs directory and commit only normalized results.
Do not expose raw prompts, transcripts, patches, logs, or private tests to the assistants.
Do not use OpenRouter, enable Anthropic usage credits, or change account limits.
Do not treat Ollama's zero reported cost as proof of zero underlying hosting cost.
Do not rank model quality from this harness feature pilot.
